newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash April wheat down in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash April wheat down in slow trade.

text.p: Argentine April wheat slipped in slow cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with slow export sales sapping enthusiasm from local buyers, traders said.

The price paid to farmers for April wheat lost $1 to $139. Spot wheat prices were squeezed up by rain slowing deliveries, and Bahia Blanca prices rose $1 to $131. Cash April maize was steady at $100 in slow trade. May soybeans shed $1 to $248, in low turnover. April sunflower seed fell $5 to $197, with heavy liquidation of speculative positions. Oil price levels were failing to provide any support to sunseed.
